item.text:
ResStock includes **high-rise apartment buildings**, but excludes **dormitories and assisted care facilities**.

| Building type | Included? |
|---|---|
| Dormitories | No |
| Assisted care facilities | No |
| High-rise apartment buildings | Yes |

ResStock follows the U.S. Energy Information Administration’s definition of a **housing unit**, which excludes congregate housing such as dormitories and assisted care facilities. High-rise multifamily housing is included, even when building codes classify it as commercial. See the introduction of the [2025 ResStock Technical Reference](https://nrel.github.io/ResStock.github.io/assets/trd/ResStockTechnicalReferenceGuide_2025_1.pdf).
